blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested a suspected high-value drug target and seized around 275.55 grams of suspected shabu worth P1.87 million, along with firearms, ammunition, and drug paraphernalia, during a search operation in Barangay Bagumbayan in the Oriental Mindoro town of Roxas on Thursday (Sept. 24). Police said the suspect, a 41-year-old resident of Sitio Madugo in Barangay Bagumbayan, was detained at his home at around 11 a.m. after authorities served two search warrants issued by the Roxas Regional Trial Court Branch 43 in Roxas on Sept. 21.
